Do you agree with what our software called?

Two things. First a steatosis ladder so I can learn where your grade cutoffs sit. Then ballooning calls it already made — I want to know which are wrong.

Steatosis — where do the grades change?

Left of each pair is the plain field, right is the same field with what our software called fat outlined in blue. Ordered by how much fat we measured, lowest to highest.

Ask: “Going up this ladder, where does grade 1 become 2, and 2 become 3? And is the blue outline catching the right things?”

Ballooning — which of these did we get wrong?

Red outline is the cell in question. We already sorted these into yes and no.

Ask: “Which ones did we get wrong — in either direction?”
We called these ballooned
We rejected these
Labels are S1–S12 for steatosis, P1–P8 for what we called ballooned, N1–N8 for what we rejected — so we can both refer to the same panel. Mouse liver, H&E, 20×. “Score” is our internal ranking, not a grade.
